newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends down on strong greenback demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends down on strong greenback demand.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended lower against its U.S. counterpart on Tuesday as strong local demand for the U.S. dollar outweighed the greenback's slide in Japan and other overseas markets, dealers said.
The Taiwan dollar finished at T$27.775 against Monday's T$27.753 close, off an opening high of T$27.740.
Turnover through dealers was heavy at US$354 million.
"There was strong demand for the greenback, including demand by the military to pay for overseas weapons procurements among other items," said a dealer of a foreign bank.
The demand forced down the local unit despite the U.S. dollar's weakness overseas, dealers said.
A T$27.70-27.80 trading range was seen for Wednesday.
